import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Rename columns for easier access
column_names = {
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)': 'Authority',
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1': 'Composite Score'
}
df.rename(columns=column_names, inplace=True)

# Filter the dataset for authorities with a composite score less than 10000
filtered_df = df[df['Composite Score'] < 10000]

# Save the filtered dataset to a new CSV file
filtered_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
